note: Per-TYPE recipes for the province place taxonomy (Phase 11 Part 1, decision 0041). One row per taxonomy type; taxonomy.json is derived from this file. Digest: docs/research/settlement-type-recipes.md.

schema.recordScope: poi = its own catalogue record, counts toward the province total; district = authored inside a parent settlement's blueprint; dressing = placed in quantity by the compiler from a density rule. ONLY recordScope=poi countBands sum to the 600-740 province total.
schema.variants: dressing/state deltas, never a different siting grammar
schema.slots: the five-slot POI recipe (docs/research/openworld-place-distribution-and-siting.md 3.1) as this type's deltas: cue, population, props, rewardFree + rewardGated, satellite (200-400 m). Cues must be tall, close, lit or AUDIBLE - the scour found no long sightlines below the mountain rim.
schema.siting: meso-rung siting grammar (module 40 28b). landformClasses are terrain-scour classes plus the pseudo-classes any-firm-ground / any-shallow-marsh / any-channel-bank, and are RANKED PREFERENCES, not requirements - enclosed-clearing (6 province-wide) and sinkhole (11) are genuinely scarce and must be budgeted. regionClasses are worldgen regions.REGION_CLASSES names.
schema.magnitude: SETTLEMENT SCALE ONLY (M1-M5). null means 'not a settlement', not 'unset' - a reef and a grave field have no magnitude by definition. Do not treat this as a universal size axis.
schema.cultures: whose place this is. The two-culture KIT rule still binds (material-culture dossier): argonian and imperial kits never blend. dunmer places build from dunmer-telvanni; khajiit, altmer and nord from the imperial/market families; lost-peoples marks the five vanished cultures whose ruins are nobody's inheritance.
schema.season: all = present year-round; wet/dry = exists or is reachable in one half of the cycle; varies = state changes seasonally (see statuses)
schema.assetPlan: inventory family ids. The withdrawn darkwater pool must never appear.
schema.assetGaps: permanent no-Nexus-answer gaps. grave-stakes = build staked-dead fields from cairns, totems and stockade pikes; working-props = distinguish works sites by LAYOUT and dressing, never bespoke machinery.
schema.countBand: [min,max] expected instances province-wide, non-uniform by causal gradient
